homeInnerContentTitle: GGenius — a platform for MLBB players in Ukraine
homeInnerContentSub: Our platform helps Mobile Legends: Bang Bang players find a team, participate in tournaments, improve their game, and manage their profile — all through a convenient Telegram bot.
whatinnerSub: GGenius is a Telegram platform for MLBB players that combines everything you need for team play, competition, and skill development in one bot. Here you can:
whatinnerListItemSub1: GGenius helps you quickly find teammates to play with. Choose by age, role, play style, or language, and form a team for rankings and tournaments.
whatinnerListItemSub2: The platform offers tournaments of various formats, from local to amateur leagues. Choose one, register in a few clicks, and follow all the details on Telegram.
whatinnerListItemSub3: Want to host your own tournament? GGenius provides all the tools you need to organize it, from brackets to results and notifications.
whatinnerListItemSub4: AI analyzes your MLBB stats and gives personalized advice to improve your gameplay and rank.
workInnerSub: Everything happens right in Telegram — a convenient and intuitive way to access the team, tournaments, and progress.

privacyInnerSubs: Processing of personal data · GGenius project
privacyInnerContentListItemParties: Purpose of collection and third-party transfers
privacyInnerContentInfoSub: We follow the principle of Data Minimization — we collect only the minimum that is critically necessary for the ecosystem to function.
privacyInnerContentInfoCategoryListItemS: Transaction history, order timestamps, game packages
privacyInnerContentInfoCategoryNoteSub: All collected data are strictly technical identifiers. No personal data (full name, address, phone number) is collected.
privacyInnerContentInfoRedListItemSub: We NEVER ask you to provide the password for your Moonton, VK, Facebook, Google, or any other service account.
privacyInnerContentInfoRedListItemSubPay: We DO NOT collect or store bank card numbers, CVV codes, or expiration dates. Entry of these details occurs exclusively on the acquirer's secure servers (WayForPay).
privacyInnerContentInfoFlowSub: We make the data processing flow as transparent as possible:
privacyInnerContentInfoFlowListItemTitle: 1. The user provides only User ID + Zone ID.
2. GGenius generates an order UUID — payment details are NOT stored.
3. GGenius sends to WayForPay: the amount + order UUID.
4. WayForPay requests card details isolated from GGenius.
5. WayForPay returns a webhook: payment successful — without card data.
6. GGenius sends to the Moonton API: User ID + Zone ID.
7. The Moonton API returns: crediting status (Success).
8. The user receives a Telegram receipt confirming completion.
privacyInnerContentInfoFlowNoteSub: GGenius never receives or stores card payment details. All card-processing occurs exclusively on the acquirer's secure servers (WayForPay or LiqPay).
privacyInnerContentInfoPartTitle: 4. Purpose of collection and third‑party transfers
privacyInnerContentInfoPartListItemTitle: 1. Fulfillment of the Public Offer terms (crediting diamonds/passes).
2. Operation of AI assistants (Faiss Vector Memory) for personalizing bot responses (stored locally).
TableBodySub: We do not sell data to marketers or advertising networks.
privacyInnerContentInfoSecListItemSub: All connections to the bot and website use HTTPS/WSS protocols with TLS 1.3.
privacyInnerContentInfoSecListItemSub2: Data is stored in a closed PostgreSQL database cluster with access restricted at the VPC level. Redis is used with an IP whitelist.
privacyInnerContentInfoSecListItemSub3: Data is retained for the period required for accounting purposes, after which it is anonymized or deleted.
privacyInnerContentInfoUserSub: Under Article 8 of the Law of Ukraine "On Personal Data Protection", you have the right to:
privacyInnerContentInfoUaserListItemSub: learn about the sources of collection and the purpose of data processing.
privacyInnerContentInfoUaserListItemSub2: obtain information about the conditions for granting third-party access to the data.
privacyInnerContentInfoUaserListItemSub3: request deletion of your personal data from our system
privacyInnerContentInfoUaserListItemSub4: withdraw consent to data processing at any time (which, however, will make it impossible to continue providing Platform services).

aboutInnerHeaderSub: GGenius is a Ukrainian eSports ecosystem for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang players that works right where your team already is — in Telegram. It's a full platform: team search, tournaments, AI analytics and in‑game currency purchases — all in one Telegram account and on the website.
aboutInnerContTitleStart: 🚀 Why GGenius is the new standard
aboutInnerContSubStart:
Single Message Interface (SMI)



The entire interface lives within a single message that updates dynamically. No spam in chat, no confusion — navigation like a native app, but without installing extra software.
aboutInnerContSubStartAi:
AI game analytics



The platform uses integrated AI (GPT-4.2) to analyze statistics and suggest hero picks. It adapts to your rank and personal playstyle.
aboutInnerContSubStartAcc:
One account everywhere



The Telegram bot and website work as a single system. Profile, team, rating and activity synchronize in real time across devices.
aboutInnerContSubPlat: Players: find teammates by rank and role in seconds; participate in tournaments, duels and community events — increase your rating and visibility.
aboutInnerContSubPlatAi: Organizers and clan leaders: create and run tournaments for up to 64 teams without spreadsheets or manual work; automatic bracket, ban system, match scheduling, participant notifications and final posters — all in one place.
aboutInnerContSubPlatAcc: Streamers and communities: run events for your audience with automated application collection; GGenius handles organization — you focus on content and audience engagement.
aboutInnerContSubinside: Tournament system: full cycle from registration to finals — automatic bracket, hero bans, statistics and instant notifications;
aboutInnerContSubinsideAi: Smart team search: live profiles with real data (not forms); filters by skill level, role and winrate;
aboutInnerContSubinsideAcc: Game content: PvP duels, Elo arena, clan rankings and activity between tournaments;
aboutInnerContSubinsideAlm: Secure diamond purchases: in‑game currency is available via ggenius.gg; card payments through secure acquirer WayForPay with automatic crediting.
aboutInnerContSubSecurity: GGenius is an independent Ukrainian high‑load project built to grow esports in Ukraine.

aboutInnerContSubSecurityAcc: - Operations are official: sole proprietor registration, public offer and secure bank acquiring;

donateInnerDescriptSub:
Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Diamonds are an in‑game currency that can be used to purchase various items and features in the game. Diamonds can be obtained by buying them in the game with real money or by participating in various in‑game events and completing certain tasks. They can also be awarded for participation in events, tournaments, and giveaways organized by the game developers. Diamonds can be used to buy a variety of in‑game items such as heroes, skins, emotes, and other cosmetic items. They can also be used to purchase certain game features, such as hero trial cards and conversion of Battle Points (BP).



In addition, diamonds can be used to purchase hero skins, emotes, and even convert to BP. They can also be bought in bulk, usually at a discounted price, as bundles or packs. Note that availability and prices of these items and features may vary depending on the region or country you are in. While diamonds can enhance your gaming experience, they are not required to enjoy the game. The decision to purchase diamonds is up to the player.
